boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Macalester College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with directly verified late availability, from campus service through late Saint Paul options.

cards.title: The Grille
cards.subtitle: Ruth Stricker Dayton Campus Center, Macalester College
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center option when you need food without leaving campus; check the dining page for holiday and break exceptions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: On-campus food service with a 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester lists The Grille in the Campus Center as open until 10:00 p.m. daily during its weekly schedule.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 7:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday–Friday and 1:00–10:00 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Pizza Lucé St. Paul
cards.subtitle: 1183 Selby Avenue, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Plan a Selby Avenue pickup or sit-down meal; the location page lists both dine-in and delivery/curbside availability through 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Selby Avenue restaurant listed open until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Lucé’s St. Paul location page lists dine-in and delivery/curbside hours until 1:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows dine-in and delivery/curbside from 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Mickey’s Diner By Willy
cards.subtitle: 1950 Seventh Street West, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Keep this West Seventh diner in reserve for a meal at an unusual hour; confirm any holiday or operational changes directly before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Paul diner whose official site states 24-hour, year-round service.
cards.evidence_claim: Mickey’s Diner By Willy states on its official website that it operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
cards.access_notes: Official site states: “24 Hours a day . . . 365 Days a Year.”

cards.title: Taco Bell — 565 N Snelling
cards.subtitle: 565 N Snelling, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes; the official location page separates late drive-thru hours from earlier dine-in availability.
cards.short_summary: A Snelling Avenue drive-thru listed as late as 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 565 N Snelling until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 6:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 6:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell — 1672 Rice Street
cards.subtitle: 1672 Rice Street, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Consider this Rice Street location for a late drive-thru order; verify the location page on the day, as posted hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Paul Taco Bell listed open until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Saint Paul location directory lists the 1672 Rice Street restaurant as open until 4:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Saint Paul, Minnesota
cards.access_notes: The official city directory lists 1672 Rice Street as “Open til 4:00AM” and identifies it as offering drive-thru service.

cards.title: Taco Bell — 1630 Robert Street South
cards.subtitle: 1630 Robert Street South, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use this South Saint Paul drive-thru option for a later order, rather than relying on the earlier posted dine-in closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Robert Street drive-thru listed through 3 a.m. on later-week nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1630 Robert Street South drive-thru until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours run to 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell — 1940 Suburban Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1940 Suburban Avenue, Saint Paul
cards.notes: For the east-side route, use the late drive-thru schedule and check it before leaving; the dining room has separate earlier hours.
cards.short_summary: An east Saint Paul drive-thru listed until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 1940 Suburban Avenue drive-thru until 1:00 a.m. most days and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 7:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in ends earlier.

cards.title: Wendy’s — 1770 University Avenue West
cards.subtitle: 1770 University Avenue West, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the Midway location for a late food run; its official page lists the same closing time for restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue restaurant listed open until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. every day at 1770 University Avenue West.
cards.access_notes: Official location hours list both restaurant and drive-thru service from 6:30 a.m. to 2:00 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Wendy’s — 612 West University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 612 West University Avenue, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use this University Avenue location when an all-hours option fits the route; confirm service details with the restaurant before traveling overnight.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Paul Wendy’s listed open 24 hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours every day at 612 West University Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s — 255 East Maryland Avenue
cards.subtitle: 255 East Maryland Avenue, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Keep this Maryland Avenue location as another all-hours food option; use the official page to reconfirm access before making a late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Paul Wendy’s listed open 24 hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours every day at 255 East Maryland Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
